why: Each box has one straight line (flat or standing) and one slanting line. Boxes opposite each other share the straight line: top-right and bottom-left both have a standing line, so bottom-right gets a flat line like top-left. Each column keeps the same slant, so bottom-right slants from bottom-left to top-right like top-right. Option 3 fits. Option 1 has the flat line but the wrong slant.
trick: Split each box into two parts (straight line and slant) and find the rule for each.
